A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]]''' lived at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] History.

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Jedi Sentinel" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artist [[Nate Temple]]. Most cards of the game depict the events of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], though exceptions such as the [[Wall of light]] were rare, but still possible. Therefore, it is impossible to determine the time period this Jedi lived in without additional information.
